label.description: Evidence level from docs/evidence-standard.md, or not-incident if excluded.

exclusion.description: Exclusion reason when label is not-incident; null otherwise.

category.description: The judge's independent reading of the nature of the edit.

confidence.description: Confidence score from 1 to 5 regarding the assigned label.

evidence.description: 1 to 4 strings quoted verbatim from the diff, insertions, or removals.

reason_en.description: At most 2 sentences in English naming the level rule that decided the label.
